collection.description: It is mending day at the camp, and two Heathens who had a sharp word are given the same net.

description_variants.description: It is mending day at the camp, and two Isolans who had a sharp word are given the same net.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: Once a month, the camp spends a day mending: nets, mats, baskets, masks, fences, friendships. (subject) and (friend), who had a sharp word with each other last week, are given the same net to mend. By the time it's done they are talking again. Nobody is sure whether that was an accident.
